propositions: Add a reducer-maintained plan_review_phase field to compiled state, set to 'execution' for in_progress status and 'planning' for open status, preserved for other targets, never updated by losing fork events.
Execution phase attestations require priority_floor >= 0.80; planning phase accepts all valid attestations; incompatible or malformed phase/floor combinations are rejected with explicit phase_status.
Manifest must emit review-phase and execution-only priority-floor lines in exact order after advisory and before rebar-version, with single-space ASCII separation and strict grammar validation.
Plan review signatures must capture immutable phase and floor at generation time before LLM/probe execution; re-sign parses v2 JSON sidecar fields and refuses incompatible or malformed recovery.
Execution Pass-3 applies a hard 0.80 minimum blocking threshold only when blocking is enabled; planning Pass-3 preserves original thresholds.

Generation collection retries at most three times for tracker HEAD instability, requires under-lock HEAD re-verification before signature commit, and returns unsigned on LLM/provider failure without writing ticket events.
